User runs a small artisanal business selling homemade jams, candles, and soaps at local markets. Sales so far this year: Mar 18 Downtown Farmers Market $220; Mar 25 Arts and Crafts Fair $85; Apr 1 Earth Day Market $25; May 6 Downtown Farmers Market $350; May 13 Mother’s Day Market $200; May 20 Foodie Festival $400; plus a latest Downtown Farmers Market visit earning $420. Total known gross sales: $1,700. Expenses and net earnings remain unknown. The Foodie Festival was highly successful and helped clear old inventory. Candles are nearly sold out and supplies need restocking; strawberry jam is a best-selling flavor, so jam supplies should be prioritized after checking production time, seasonal demand, ingredient availability, and upcoming large orders. For inventory, count stock, forecast demand, add buffers, confirm supplier lead times, and monitor/reorder as needed.

User planned a points-based loyalty program with tiered rewards and is considering a modest sign-up bonus. Promotion will use social media, email newsletters, in-store messaging, and trained staff at checkout. Keep enrollment simple and benefits/rules clear.
